tool.name: COMEBin-LLMopt
tool.description: faster COMEBin: binning of metagenomic contigs using COntrastive Multi-viEw representation learning
tool.command:
#import re
mkdir 'outputs' 'bam_files' &&
#set $safename_fasta = re.sub('[^\w\-_\.]', '_', str($assembly_file.element_identifier)) ## Copy, not link: COMEBin writes gene-call caches next to the resolved assembly path. cp '$assembly_file' '${safename_fasta}.fasta' &&
#for $file in $bam_files: #set $safename = re.sub('[^\w\-_\.]', '_', str($file.element_identifier)) ln -s '$file' './bam_files/${safename}.bam' && #end for
comebin-llmopt -a '${safename_fasta}.fasta' -o 'outputs' -p 'bam_files' -t "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-12}" #if str($loss): -l ${loss} #end if -n ${learning} -e ${emb_comebin} -c ${emb_cov} -b ${batch} -m ${max_edges} -L ${min_length} #if str($seed): -s ${seed} #end if -d 'cpu'
## COMEBin-LLMopt exits 0 without bins when no marker-gene seeds are found; ## create empty outputs in that case. && mkdir -p 'outputs/comebin_res/comebin_res_bins' && touch 'outputs/comebin_res/comebin_res.tsv'

param.name: bam_files
param.label: Input bam file(s)
param.help: One BAM file per sample with the reads mapped to the assembly.

param.name: loss
param.label: Temperature in loss function
param.help: Leave empty for the automatic choice (COMEBin-LLMopt only): 0.07 if the N50 of the binned contigs is above 10 kb, otherwise 0.15.

param.name: max_edges
param.label: HNSW neighbours retained per contig
param.help: Capped automatically at the number of contigs minus one.

param.name: min_length
param.label: Minimum contig length to bin
param.help: COMEBin-LLMopt only. Shorter contigs stay unbinned. For large assemblies (about 100k contigs) 2500 cuts the run time several-fold.

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed
param.help: COMEBin-LLMopt only. Set a seed for reproducible results; leave empty for a random seed.

tool.help:
**What it does**
COMEBin-LLMopt is a modified, faster version of COMEBin 1.1.0 (the **COMEBin** tool in this Tool Shed). It bins metagenomic contigs with contrastive multi-view representation learning: it builds several fragments (views) of each contig and learns embeddings of coverage and k-mer features, then clusters them with Leiden.
**Differences from the COMEBin tool**
- **Faster:** about 2.6–2.8× shorter run time on CPUs (faster loss, training batches, coverage features and dropout), with the same bin quality within seed noise. - **Minimum contig length** (new): bin only contigs above a length, for example 2500 bp for large assemblies. - **Random seed** (new): reproducible runs. - **Temperature:** chosen automatically from the assembly N50 when left empty (COMEBin always uses the value given, 0.15 by default). - **More robust:** small assemblies (HNSW neighbours are capped), assemblies without marker-gene seeds (empty output instead of an error) and CheckM failures. - **Extra output:** a contig-to-bin table.
The changes are listed at https://github.com/paulzierep/COMEBin-LLMopt/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.
**Input**
- The assembly file in FASTA format. - The corresponding BAM file(s), one per sample, with reads mapped to the assembly.
**Output**
- A collection with one FASTA file per bin. - A two-column table: contig ID and bin.
Bins with less than 200 kb of sequence are not reported, so very small assemblies can give empty outputs.
The run time is still high for large assemblies, since this is a machine learning tool.
